name: Knight’s Focus
body:
You are able to cast spells even while faced with the worst possible conditions.

Prerequisite(s): Iron Will, Eldritch Knight level 2nd

Benefit: You gain a +4 bonus to all concentration checks made to resist losing a spell due to taking damage, grappling, vigorous or violent motion, weather conditions, or entanglement. This bonus does not apply when you attempt to cast a spell defensively.
